title: GTA 6 has not been released yet, but fake torrents are already circulating with malware and payment scams
content_md:
GTA 6 has not been released yet, but fake torrents are already circulating. Some files hide malware, while others demand payment for copies that do not exist.

via Mastodon https://elfolio.es/gta-6-pirata-y-falsos-torrents/
exclude_reason: Generic consumer warning about GTA 6 torrent scams, already covered as a low-value story and no new technical detail.
